sources.verified_angle_summary: At LEAP 2026, Mobiz is exhibiting alongside Microsoft and launching three new enterprise solutions: the Audit Ready Compliance Platform, an Agentic Software Development Platform, and a Multi-Cloud Migration Accelerator. These solutions address critical challenges in continuous compliance, AI-powered software development lifecycle, and structured Azure migration. Dr. Akber Gardezi, Mobiz's Regional Lead for MEA, will also present on accelerating business transformation through Copilot integration at the Microsoft Booth. This specific launch of three distinct enterprise solutions provides a concrete news angle distinct from generic AI or cloud announcements.
sources.verified_key_facts: Mobiz is a Microsoft Solutions Partner with 9 specializations and a Microsoft Fabric Featured Partner; At LEAP 2026, Mobiz is launching three enterprise solutions: Audit Ready, Agentic Software Development Platform, and Multi-Cloud Migration Accelerator; Audit Ready provides a live view of compliance readiness and maps evidence to controls; The Agentic Software Development Platform uses AI-assisted planning, development, and testing to accelerate software delivery; The Multi-Cloud Migration Accelerator helps assess environments and generate a structured migration roadmap to Azure; Dr. Akber Gardezi, Regional Lead for MEA, will speak at the Microsoft Booth on August 31, 2026, about Copilot integration.
